name: Proscaline
toxicity: no negative health effects attributed to trying this drug
summary: An uncommon psychedelic stimulant phenethylamine and analogue of mescaline with reportedly similar effects. The drug is roughly 5-7 times more potent than mescaline by weight.

pharmacology.text: Proscaline is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. Activation of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor is thought to be responsible for its psychedelic effects. The drug is much more potent as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor than as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A or 5-HT2B receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: Proscaline appeared for sale on the online research chemical market in the 2010s.

summaryZh: 丙基麥司卡林是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C13H21NO3，屬於苯乙胺衍生物中的3,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺衍生物（「司卡林類化合物」），為一種策劃藥，2024年被列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
summaryZhHans: 丙基麦司卡林是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C13H21NO3，属于苯乙胺衍生物中的3,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺衍生物（“司卡林类化合物”），为一种策划药，2024年被列入《非药用类麻醉药品和精神药品名录》。

sideEffects.en: It has been little studied. Reported effects include nausea, body discomfort, anxiety, a faster heart rate and raised blood pressure, and like other psychedelics it can cause frightening experiences and trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 相關研究很少。已知效應包括噁心、身體不適、焦慮、心跳加快和血壓升高，和其他迷幻藥一樣，它可能帶來驚恐的經驗，並在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 相关研究很少。已知效应包括恶心、身体不适、焦虑、心跳加快和血压升高，和其他迷幻药一样，它可能带来惊恐的经验，并在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: Proscaline is mescaline with its middle methoxy group replaced by a propoxy group. Alexander Shulgin described it in his book PiHKAL.
fact.zh: 丙基麥司卡林是把麥司卡林中間的甲氧基換成丙氧基。Alexander Shulgin 在他的書《PiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: 丙基麦司卡林是把麦司卡林中间的甲氧基换成丙氧基。Alexander Shulgin 在他的书《PiHKAL》中描述过它。
